But the person went on: Life has no inherent meaning, they said, except that which you define as meaningful.

Objectively, meaning is synonymous with the natural state of a thing and all possible interrelations in space and time this thing may have with other things. It's quite broad and emotionally neutral. Things are meaningful subjectively for an individual or a society based on their own chosen definitions for those things.

I choose to believe that there is value and meaning in the process of overcoming challenges as a society. I choose to believe that there is value and meaning in the stories we create and share with one another. I choose to believe that my thoughts and feelings about those around me are valuable and meaningful. From a wholly objective universal viewpoint, perhaps they are not meaningful.
